name: Zephras Isle
changed: New floating sky-island starting zone for the Skyborne race; Skyborne of either faction start here and leave by airship from Valanaar around level 12.
highlights: Valanaar and Valanaar Skydocks (airship links to Alliance and Horde)
Thendal Village (where the zone storyline begins)
Shen'dar Village, Falaath Village, Shrine of Akir

name: Riverglades
changed: New frontier zone in south-eastern Khaz Modan (east of Badlands/Burning Steppes, bordering Redridge and Swamp of Sorrows) with 150+ quests and a neutral goblin port.
highlights: Powderfuse Port (neutral goblin port, boat to Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris)
Sunnyglade, Windstead, Meadowsbrook, Wheeler's Grange, Twilight's Shroud, Terral's Watch

name: Shen'dralas
changed: New zone in central Kalimdor between Desolace, Feralas and Mulgore, reached from Desolace through the Valley of Bones; story follows the Shen'dralar Highborne exiles and the Magram/Gelkis centaur conflict. Level range varies by source (Warcraft Tavern gives minimum recommended 40; mein-mmo 45-55; wiki lists it as unknown).
highlights: Quests tie into Dire Maul, Razorfen Downs and Maraudon

name: Mount Hyjal
changed: New level-60 endgame zone set after Archimonde's defeat, with the forests recovering; reached on foot from Winterspring via Darkwhisper Gorge. Houses multiple questlines, reputations and the two new raids.
highlights: Cradle of Tranquility, Dae'gun, Elderwild, Malorne's Retreat, Mourning's Rest
Shrine of Aviana, Summit of Eternity, Tainted Foothills

name: Elwynn Forest
changed: Starting zones in Forever were upgraded with campsites, expanded local quests and early profession hooks (per Gfinity).

name: Dun Morogh
changed: Starting zone upgraded with campsites and expanded local quests; Gnomeregan entrance here.

name: Tirisfal Glades
changed: Flagged by the wiki as substantively changed on the Forever map; the new Ruins of Lordaeron dungeon sits in the ruined city above the Undercity, entered near the Brill-side approach.

name: Mulgore
changed: Flagged by the wiki as substantively changed on the Forever map (borders the new Shen'dralas zone).

name: Westfall
highlights: Start of the Cozy Sleeping Bag quest chain (level 14+)

name: Darkshore
changed: Auberdine is a stop on the Menethil Harbor - Southshore - Auberdine ferry loop and also linked to Stormwind Harbor.

name: The Barrens
changed: Hosts a Darkspear Islands battlemaster; Northwatch has the Alliance Theramore Expeditionary Force base with a portal to the battleground, and the Barrens is a Cozy Sleeping Bag chain start.
highlights: Wailing Caverns, Razorfen Kraul, Razorfen Downs

name: Redridge Mountains
changed: Flagged by the wiki as substantively changed on the Forever map; borders the new Riverglades.

name: Wetlands
changed: Expanded with 25+ new quests, a reworked leveling flow and the new Excavation Site: Wetlands dungeon at Whelgar's Excavation; Menethil Harbor runs a ferry loop to Southshore and Auberdine.

name: Hillsbrad Foothills
changed: Southshore is a ferry stop; Southshore (Alliance) and Tarren Mill (Horde) start the City of Dalaran attunement quests.
highlights: Emissary Jacques in Southshore ("An Alarming Request")
Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill ("Key to the City")

name: Alterac Mountains
changed: Substantively changed map: Dalaran's barrier has fallen and the restored city is a playable area with its own quests and the City of Dalaran dungeon.

name: Desolace
changed: Flagged as substantively changed on the Forever map; gains campsites and expanded quests and connects to Shen'dralas through the Valley of Bones.

name: Stranglethorn Vale
changed: New underwater-entrance dungeon The Drowned City off the coast west of Grom'gol; Booty Bay's Pix Xizzix trades for Tarnished Undermine Reals.

name: Badlands
changed: Borders the new Riverglades.

name: Dustwallow Marsh
changed: Alcaz Island now holds the Alcaz Prison dungeon; the Darkspear Islands battleground lies off its coast; Onyxia's Lair returns as a 40-player raid.

name: Swamp of Sorrows
changed: Borders the new Riverglades.

name: Tanaris
changed: New boat route from Steamwheedle Port to Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

name: Azshara
changed: A long-sealed furbolg gate in northern Azshara now leads to the Blackmaw Hold dungeon (portal sits on the Winterspring side).

name: Un'Goro Crater
changed: New titan dungeon Shaper's Terrace on the northern hills above Marshal's Refuge, powered by crystals gathered around the crater.

name: Eastern Plaguelands
changed: Flagged by the wiki as substantively changed on the Forever map (details not given).

name: Winterspring
changed: Connects west to Mount Hyjal through Darkwhisper Gorge and has one of the Barrow Deeps raid entrances; Blackmaw Hold's portal is on its map.

name: Stormwind City
changed: Flagged as substantively changed on the Forever map; Stormwind Harbor sails to Auberdine.

name: Ironforge
changed: New Hall of Thanes dungeon beneath the city, entered at the High Seat.

name: Undercity
highlights: Ruins of Lordaeron dungeon above the city
